# PJA Carpentry Services

> Bespoke kitchens, fitted bedrooms and high-end carpentry across Gloucestershire, the Cotswolds and the Forest of Dean. Paul Anderson is rated by his clients as the best kitchen fitter in Gloucester, with more than 30 years on the tools and a 5.0 rating on Google. Family run since 2010.

Key facts:
- Brand: PJA Carpentry Services (Gloucester, UK)
- Lead: kitchens designed, supplied and hand-fitted, with photorealistic CAD design included as part of the project
- Also: fitted bedrooms and dressing rooms, bespoke carpentry, major home improvement projects managed end to end, and property maintenance
- Quotations are free and no obligation; every job is priced individually
- £2m public liability insurance
- Contact is by the website contact form or paul@pjacs.co.uk
